name: tag
title: Tag
purpose: A small neutral label for a category or a filter value, with an optional remove button.
whenToUse: For the categories an item belongs to: labels on a task, the language of a repository.
For each filter applied to a list or a table, with a remove button, in a row above it.
Several at once, in a ds-cluster. Tags are scanned, and no one of them is more important than the next.
whenNotToUse: For a status, such as Failed or Awaiting decision. Use a badge, which has tones and icons. A tag is neutral only.
For something the reader presses to go somewhere or to switch a filter on. Use a link or a button.
For a fact that is not a category, such as a count or a time. Write it as plain text.
For a count on an icon or a tab. Write the count as text.

variants.name: default
variants.use: Text only, on a span, or on an li when the tags are a list.

variants.name: removable
variants.use: The same tag with a button of the class ds-tag__remove after the text. No modifier class is needed.

sizes.name: default
sizes.use: 24px tall with 12px text. A removable tag keeps 8px clear above and below it, so its button's pointer target has room when tags wrap.

accessibility: Use a span. When the tags are a set, such as the filters in force, use a ul with an aria-label that says what they are and an li with the class ds-tag for each.
Write a filter as its name and its value, such as Branch: main, so the tag makes sense out of context.

The remove button is a button element with the class ds-tag__remove and no content. The stylesheet draws its cross. Its aria-label says what it removes and repeats the tag's text: Remove filter: Branch: main.
The button is drawn 22px square, inside the tag's border, and its pointer target is 44px square. Lay removable tags out with ds-cluster so the targets of neighbouring buttons do not overlap.

Tab reaches each remove button in order, and Enter and Space activate it. After a tag is removed, the app moves focus to the next tag's button, or to the control that adds filters when none is left, and says what changed in a role="status" element.
Set the disabled attribute on the button while its filter cannot be removed. A tag with no button at all cannot be removed.
A tag has one tone and never carries meaning by colour.
